article.headline: Treyson Anderson scores 23 as North Dakota State takes down UMKC 97-73
article.description: — Treyson Anderson's 23 points helped North Dakota State defeat UM-Kansas City 97-73 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Treyson Anderson scores 23 as North Dakota State takes down UMKC 97-73

article.story: KANSAS CITY, Mo. -- — Treyson Anderson's 23 points helped North Dakota State defeat UM-Kansas City 97-73 on Thursday. Anderson added eight rebounds for the Bison (13-5, 3-0 Summit League). Trevian Carson scored 17 points, shooting 7 for 8, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc. Damari Wheeler-Thomas finished with 16 points. The Roos (4-13, 1-2) were led by Karmello Branch, who recorded 19 points. Kasheem Grady II added 18 points for UMKC. CJ Evans finished with 12 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
